about: Permanent chat trajectory test plan. Tier 1 dialogues run VERBATIM — on the device (type each user turn into Jeeves chat) or headlessly via JeevesTests/TrajectoryTests. Tier 2 escalations are generated per run by scenario-eval.py against briefs/chat-trajectories.md; Tier 3 injects failures. After any run: pull the store, run trajectory-audit.py (deterministic) and the story-vs-state judges. A scenario passes only when BOTH agree.

fields.setup: Turns played BEFORE the scenario to create its preconditions. Not what the scenario is testing — scenarios 2 and 3 happen 'at' and 'on the way to' an event, which only means something if that event is TODAY.
fields.turns: The scenario itself, in the user's own words. Never paraphrase these.
fields.answers: Replies fed ONLY when the assistant asks a question, in order. Real users answer; a one-way script made the app's (correct) request for a missing checkout date look like a failure to act.
fields.expect: What a correct build must leave behind.

turns: Add dinner with Arvind tomorrow at 8 pm
tier1.expect: ONE event, correct day, 20:00 start with a sensible end, venue set via edit (not a second event). If no end time was given the receipt SAYS the end was assumed. Planner shows the commute leg for it.

setup: Add dinner with Priya today at 7 pm at Toit, Indiranagar
turns: I'm at the dinner, it's running long — extend it by an hour
tier1.expect: The SAME event's end moves +60 minutes — via extend_by_minutes, never a computed clock time, and never a shrink. No duplicate. A replan of the remainder is OFFERED (evening blocks after it shift), not silently skipped. Elapsed blocks before the event are not marked missed.

setup: Add movie with Karan today at 9 pm at PVR Forum Mall
turns: Stuck in traffic on the way to the movie, push it 30 minutes
tier1.expect: Start AND end move +30 together (shift_by_minutes — the duration is preserved, not stretched). Any replan uses resume_at = new start and marks blocks the delay swallowed via missed_blocks — ELAPSED IS NOT DONE.

turns: Set up a 4 day trip to Colombo starting the 20th of next month
Outbound flight UL 174 departs BLR 09:45, return UL 173 departs Colombo 20:30 on the last day, lands BLR 22:00
answers: Leaving from home in Indiranagar, and it's Bengaluru airport both ways
tier1.expect: One trip, 4 days. TWO flight journeys: outbound origin-clock IST, return origin-clock Asia/Colombo (+5:30 — same offset, zones still stamped on BOTH legs). Leave-by chains on the right days; two nudges; no duplicate trips from the second turn.

turns: I'm in Singapore till the 10th of next month, flying back SQ 510 departing 19:40 SGT, landing BLR 21:10
Next morning I drive to Mysore, staying at Radisson hotel Mysore for 2 days
Then checkout and drive to Wayanad, staying at CGH Earth Wayanad
Then checkout from Wayanad and drive back home, I want to reach home by 6 pm
answers: Two nights at Wayanad, so checkout on the 15th
Yes, drive home on the 15th to reach by 6 pm
tier1.expect: TWO trips sharing the handover day, never merged — the Mysore itinerary must NOT be absorbed into the Singapore trip. Mysore trip: Radisson stay (2 nights) + CGH Earth stay, auto drive transitions Radisson→CGH (arrive-by noon, measured), return drive with 18:00 destination-clock deadline on the RIGHT day. One journey per leg despite four turns. Handover day shows both trips' cards.

turns: Add one more day to the Mysore trip
Actually cut the last day, end it a day earlier
tier1.expect: update_trip/update_stay both times — no new trip, no duplicate, and the SHRINK must actually happen (a reply saying it went back with no tool call behind it is a fabrication). Growth sweeps plans on the new day; shrink says days go back to the planner. Receipts quote the old AND the new ranges. Any knock-on effect the reply mentions (a moved check-in) must itself be a real tool call.

turns: Change of plan — from Wayanad we go to Western Valley Resort near Ooty and stay there instead of coming straight home
answers: Two nights at Western Valley, then drive home
Keep the Wayanad stay as it is, just add Ooty after it
tier1.expect: Either update_stay (CGH→onward) plus a new Western Valley stay, or add_stay + adjusted return — but exactly ONE new stay, a measured Wayanad→Ooty drive transition, the return-home drive updated or replaced (not duplicated), and the trip window covering Ooty days.

turns: Move the Radisson stay to start a day later
Delete the stay at Western Valley
Extend whatever event I have on the 12th by two hours
tier1.expect: Each modification lands via the matching key the user chose — hotel name, date, location — with a preview/confirm on the destructive ones, receipts naming exactly what changed, and zero duplicates created by any of the four turns.

tier2.generate: OPENAI_API_KEY=... python3 tools/scenario-eval.py generate tools/briefs/chat-trajectories.md <outdir> — regenerates escalations each run; never hand-pick them.
axes: clock seams: +5:45/+6:00 offsets, red-eyes crossing midnight, deadline in destination clock
order of operations: stay before trip, calendar sync after chat built the same trip, flight before its trip
corrections + consent: 'actually make that Tuesday', bare 'Sure', correction AFTER confirmation, exact repeat of a request (idempotency)
cross-entity deletion: event vs trip vs stay in one sentence ('clear my September')
failure injection: measure timeout then manual estimate then re-measure; planner API down (fallback must respect the trip); a dropped turn (apology must surface)
interleaving: a gym replan interrupts trip planning, then 'anyway, back to the trip'
long horizon: build 3 weeks out, resync calendar twice, modify once, audit must stay clean

tier3.note: Chaos runs — execute a Tier 1 dialogue while: airplane mode toggled mid-conversation, app backgrounded mid-tool-call, watch delivering a workout summary simultaneously. Pass = graceful receipts or honest apologies; FAIL = silence, duplicates, or claimed actions that didn't happen.

gaps.note: Known coverage gaps in Tier 1 — these scenarios do not exist yet and their absence is deliberate, not forgotten.
missing: the planner itself: plan quality, replan honesty and travel-day stand-down have no dialogue of their own
fitness/Watch: no dialogue touches workouts (those bugs surface via the anomaly digest instead)
refusal path: no dialogue declines a destructive action after seeing its preview
idempotent replay: running a dialogue twice must not double anything
relaunch survival: nothing checks state after the app restarts
there is no scenario 6 — the numbering has always run 1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9

verification: Every run: python3 tools/diagnose.py <workdir> --pull  (store-audit + trajectory-audit deterministic layer), then tools/trajectory-judge.py on the artifact (Claude + GPT, strictest verdict wins, Fable 5 breaks ties). Pass requires: zero duplicate trips/stays/journeys, every assistant number traceable to a tool result, every claimed action present in the store, no unanswered turns.
